notes.title: Breakfast is not included by default
notes.body: Breakfast is not included by default. The agent can say the hotel may recommend nearby cafes, but must not promise an included breakfast service.

notes.title: Practical address handling
notes.body: For general location questions, give the public main address: Calle Pescadores 1, 03590 Altea, Alicante. If the caller needs taxi, GPS, or urgent transfer precision and mentions conflicting directions, recommend confirming with reception because Calle La Mar 54 also appears in booking-engine context.

notes.title: Reception and booking hours
notes.body: Reception or guest support runs 09:00-21:00. Phone reservations run Monday to Sunday 10:00-17:00. Online booking is available 24/7. Guests staying at the property have emergency phone support until 23:00. Do not claim 24-hour reception.

notes.title: Direct base prices for phone demo
notes.body: Use base prices directly for phone answers. Do not ask for dates to give a base nightly price. Prices apply to one or two people. If the caller gives nights, multiply the nightly base price by the number of nights.

notes.title: Direct availability for phone demo
notes.body: Use the current availability counts directly for general availability questions. Do not ask for dates unless the caller is trying to confirm a real booking for exact dates or payment.

notes.title: Final booking confirmation handoff
notes.body: The agent can help choose a room and explain current price and availability. The final reservation confirmation, payment, changes to existing bookings, and special confirmed arrangements must be handled by the reservations team or website.

notes.title: Accessibility is not documented
notes.body: The reviewed public pages do not specify wheelchair access, elevator, step-free access, or adapted rooms. Accessibility questions should be escalated to hotel staff before the guest books.

notes.title: Card brand acceptance is not documented
notes.body: The terms only say that a valid credit or debit card is required. They do not confirm Visa, Mastercard, or other specific brands. If the caller asks for a card brand, say it is not confirmed and offer to verify it with the hotel.
